headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.7560). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 14 studies yielded an effect size of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.85–1.08), indicating no statistically significant association between alcohol and uterine cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by substantial heterogeneity (I² = 73.64%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
